# RESEARCH — Facets d20 simulation: encounter tables and the balance band

*Engine builder, generated by `software/tools/d20_sim.py all` on 2026-09-28. Rules: `software/facets_d20/` (every roll through `combat.py`). Data: `facets_d20/data/*.yaml` v0.2, SRD ladder `software/facets_d20/data/srd_monsters.yaml`, SRD baselines `software/facets_d20/data/srd_baselines.yaml`. Base seed 20260928; each cell's seed is `crc32(repr((base, task key)))`, so any cell reruns alone. Raw numbers: `software/research/facets_d20_sim_results.json`. Method and decisions: `docs/DESIGN_facets_d20_engine.md`.*

## Headline

- **Clash at 4th level** (budget 27 Threat per character): 3.46 ± 0.06 rounds, 27% party HP lost, 99.5% wins, a PC drops in 19% of fights, a PC dies in 0.6%.
- **Threat model** (measured): a boss = 2.22 standards of its CR; a minion carries √(11.4 × its damage per turn); a foe that never breaks × 1.17.
- **A day of four Clashes** (two short rests) at 4th: the reference party survives it 65% of the time.
- **Balance, level 1:** 3/12 presets inside ±15% of the median PI (out: fighter, barbarian, monk, wizard, investigator, loremaster, tinker, druid, oathsworn); preset median vs SRD median +51%; combos over the ceiling: body_caster, soul_champion, body_battlemage, battle_priest_deep, paladin_max, unbreakable, reckless_striker, monk_stunner; hybrids beating a pure build: none.
- **Balance, level 4:** 3/12 presets inside ±15% of the median PI (out: fighter, barbarian, monk, wizard, investigator, loremaster, tinker, druid, oathsworn); preset median vs SRD median +15%; combos over the ceiling: body_ranger, body_battlemage, unbreakable, reckless_striker, monk_stunner; hybrids beating a pure build: tinker.
- **Balance, level 7:** 2/12 presets inside ±15% of the median PI (out: fighter, rogue, barbarian, monk, investigator, loremaster, tinker, priest, druid, oracle); preset median vs SRD median +45%; combos over the ceiling: unbreakable, reckless_striker, monk_stunner; hybrids beating a pure build: none.
- **Balance, level 10:** 3/12 presets inside ±15% of the median PI (out: fighter, rogue, monk, wizard, investigator, loremaster, druid, oracle, oathsworn); preset median vs SRD median +53%; combos over the ceiling: unbreakable, reckless_striker, monk_stunner; hybrids beating a pure build: none.

## 1. Method

- **Fights.** `sim.Fight` runs the §6.1–6.2 rules: one d20 per side for initiative (Alert = advantage), bosses act at the top of the round and again in their side's half, boss resolve, fixed monster damage (crits rolled), minions, morale (standard foes at first Bloodied, minions when the leader falls), E1 one rider a turn, one reaction, concentration, death saves, Sparks as +1d6 after a roll. The tactical AI is documented in `sim.py`'s docstring and is the same for every build.
- **Resources.** A single fight gets ¼ of each long-rest pool (rounded up, plus any short-rest regain) and all short-rest pools — one of the day's four Clashes. The day runner carries HP, pools, Hit Dice and Sparks across four fights with short rests after the 1st and 3rd, pacing pools evenly.
- **Foes for fitting.** Continuous-CR generic foes: the SRD ladder's per-CR medians (AC, HP, to-hit, damage per turn, saves), log-interpolated. Three shapes averaged: four standards; a boss (60% of the Threat) + minions; two standards + minions.
- **Tier targets** (yaml `encounter_tiers`). The search hits the middle of the tier's party-HP-lost band (Skirmish 10%, Clash 27.5%, Battle 45%); Desperate hits the middle of its win band (72.5%). Rounds, wins and drops are then checked against the rest of the targets and reported, never tuned into the table.
- **Validation.** Real SRD ladder monsters in the six composition classes of §7, 6 random encounters per class and cell.

## 5. Adjustments (Table 9–3)

| Party | skirmish | clash | battle | desperate | Rule |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Three players | -26% | -23% | -26% | -25% | remove foes worth 23% of the Threat |
| Five players | +23% | +23% | +19% | +19% | add foes worth 23% of the Threat |
| Six players | +39% | +35% | +35% | +33% | add foes worth 35% of the Threat |
| Tired (50% HP, ½ resources) | +3% | -5% | -10% | -18% | remove 5% of the Threat, or drop one tier |

Percentages are the change in the whole encounter's Threat, averaged over levels 1–10.

## 8. Balance band (§8)

Metrics per build and level, over 500 standard days (2,000 Clashes) beside three reference-party companions. **eDPR\*** = (damage dealt + healing restored to allies + enemy damage prevented for allies, incl. disabled enemy turns) ÷ rounds. **eHP** = (HP + temp HP per fight + self-healing per fight) × (0.55 ÷ measured hit rate against it) × (printed damage per hit ÷ damage actually taken per hit). **PI** = eDPR\* × eHP. DPR₁/DPR₃ = damage per round against one / three dummies (AC of the level's foes, 4 rounds).

## Findings for the Designer

- **Clash fits 3–4 rounds only at levels 1–4.** At the fitted budgets a Clash lasts 3.2–3.6 rounds at 1st–4th but 2.6–2.7 rounds at 5th–10th, with wins falling to 86–96% (target ≥ 97%). Once 3rd-level area spells and Extra Attack arrive, a fight that costs 27% of the party's HP is decided fast and swingy. No budget meets the HP, rounds and win targets together at 5th+. This is §7's "the Planner changes a rule" case (engine note E-10), for example more monster HP or less burst at 5th+.
- **Skirmish is under 2 rounds** at almost every level (target 2–3). **Battle wins 77–87%** at every level (target ≥ 90%), and **Desperate costs only 50–55% HP** from 5th (target 55–90%). The tier targets in the yaml are not mutually reachable by budget alone.
- **1st level is lethal at a Clash:** a PC drops in 71% of Clashes and dies in 15%. At 2nd: 50% / 7%. From 3rd: ≤ 25% / ≤ 2%.
- **The four-Clash day is not survivable at the fitted Clash:** the reference party wins all four fights (two short rests) on only 25–65% of days. Either a Clash should cost ~20% HP (the band's bottom), or the day should be three Clashes.
- **Threat model (measured):** a boss is worth 2.22 standards of its CR (two turns + top of round + no morale); a minion is worth √(11.4 × DPT) (it dies to one hit whatever its CR); a never-breaking foe × 1.17. Budgets scale ~6× from 1st to 10th; the three/five/six-player and tired adjustments are −23% / +23% / +35% / −5% (Clash; −18% for Desperate, i.e. drop a tier).
- **Real SRD monsters vs the table:** random real-monster encounters built to the Clash budget land in the Clash band only 32–72% of the time. The mean is close (party HP lost 23–34%) for every class except **solo bosses (44%)**, which the CR table underprices. Recommendation: a solo boss (no other foes) counts ×1.5, or the book warns that a lone boss is a Battle.
- **Robustness:** 100% of 20 random four-preset parties land in the Clash band at the 4th-level Clash budget; only 40% land in the Battle band at the Battle budget (spread 38–63% HP lost), so Battle is the party-sensitive tier.
- **Balance band (items 1–5) is not met, as the Designer's §8.1 expected:** 2–3 of 12 presets sit inside ±15% of the median PI at each level. Body runs +19–44% (d10, heavy armor and Veteran on every Body card), Mind −11 to −26%, Soul −6 to −23%. Druid and Loremaster sit ~−50% throughout (Wild Shape isn't simulated; Loremaster spends picks on non-combat talents). The preset median beats the SRD median by +15% at 4th and +45–53% at 1st/7th/10th.
- **Item 7 (hybrids pay) holds for every hybrid at 7th and 10th and for all but one at 4th: the Tinker is +161% over the best pure Mind build.** Its DPR is −26%/−40% of the pure builds'; the excess is Clockwork Guardian's guard and Field Kit's temp HP counted as prevented damage. The sim also applies the guard to the first hit on *any* ally each round, which is generous (the text says within 5 ft of the construct). Tuner item.
- **Combos over the +15% ceiling:** *unbreakable*, *reckless_striker* and *monk_stunner* at every level (Body melee with Rage/Martial Arts; the same Body excess). At 1st level most Steel-heavy builds also exceed it (*body_caster* +66%, *body_battlemage* +40%, *paladin_max* +36%, *battle_priest_deep* and *soul_champion* +33%): the d10/heavy-armor chassis dominates PI at 1st. From 4th, the audit's C1/C2 shapes (*battle_priest*, *battle_priest_deep*, *paladin_max*, *spellblade*) are inside the band at every level. *body_battlemage* is over at 4th (+24%) and *body_ranger* at 4th (+16%).
- **PI vs the swap test disagree** (Spearman 0.46–0.82): PI multiplies a build's damage by its own toughness, so Body tanks rank top, while in the swap test healers and support (Priest, *healer_engine*, *summoner*) help the party most. Recommend making the swap test the band's primary measure (E-9).
- **V21 default for Steel-main hybrids** (engine Q-3): the engine raises the main track's ability (Oathsworn Str, Tinker Dex); the Designer's harness raises the casting ability. The pinned numbers follow the engine. Set `asi:` on those presets if the Designer prefers casting.
